description: Adds a direct voltage to one signal and subtracts the same voltage from another, so a pair of signals comes out with opposite offsets

params.text: Sets the offset added to the first channel and subtracted from the second, from -10V to 10V; with a cable in the offset jack it attenuates and inverts that voltage instead
Inverts the second channel's signal before the offset is subtracted from it

inputs.text: The voltage that becomes the offset, scaled by a tenth of the knob setting
The signal the offset is added to, and the source for the second channel when the jack below is empty
The signal the offset is subtracted from

outputs.text: The first input with the offset added
The second input with the offset subtracted, inverted first when the switch is set to inverted

notes: the offsets are made for driving the wavefolding modes of Sulafat, where a signal sitting off zero folds very differently

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack above it.
